steps.clue: Temporarily power both laboratories and open the bunker.
Obtain the Skull of Nan Sapwe.
Use the Skull of Nan Sapwe to restore the hidden elevator plans.
Collect three cogs using the anti-aircraft gun, electrified zipline and Anywhere But Here!
Install the three cogs and activate the elevator.
Descend beneath the bunker and clear the roots with the upgraded Wonder Weapon.
Defeat Mutated Takeo by destroying his four exposed spores.
